title: “Why Do You Want to Work Here?” Try This Google Hack
description:
“I need to pay the bills” might be the real answer. 

But when an interviewer asks “Why do you want to work here?” you need something better.

Here’s a Google search hack most job seekers miss: use Google to find a company’s press releases and investor reports before your interview.

You’ll uncover company priorities, recent wins, new initiatives, and talking points you can actually use to build a stronger interview answer.

Less generic company research. Better interview answers.

#JobInterview #InterviewTips #JobSearch #CareerAdvice #Shorts
transcript: I need to pay the bills, idiot. Is the answer we all want to give deep down inside every time we're asked, "Why do you want to work for this company?" But that's definitely not going to get us the job. We need to come off as an insider who can solve their problems immediately. Check out this inside hack that helps you do company research quick that makes you sound like that insider, and make sure to follow for more. I opened a tab in Google. Into the search bar, I typed site {colon} you're going to put the name of the company you're researching or interviewing for, file type {colon} PDF and press release. This brought me to this article right here, which is a press release for the company. I can click on that, read this over, and find out some insider information that may not have even hit their website yet that I can use in application materials or in my interview that is really going to set me apart as a standout candidate.
